adjudication.rationale: The diff explicitly changes `GroupsController#members` from `render_serialized(members.to_a, GroupUserSerializer)` to a JSON object with `members:` plus `meta: { total, limit, offset }`, and applies `limit`/`offset` pagination to all groups with a new default `limit` of 50 (`app/controllers/groups_controller.rb`). The frontend `Discourse.Group#findMembers()` was updated to consume this new shape (`result.members` and `result.meta.*`), but there is no spec added/updated for `GroupsController#members` to lock down this response contract (only `spec/controllers/admin/groups_controller_spec.rb` changes are present). This is a concrete, diff-grounded review concern about untested API contract and pagination behavior, even if the immediate Ember consumer was updated.
